items.followUp: Define empirical formula and write the empirical formula of hydrogen peroxide, H₂O₂.

rubric.why: The definition must identify the simplest whole-number ratio of atoms in a compound.
rubric.description: Defines an empirical formula as the simplest whole-number ratio of atoms of each element in a compound.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating the defining idea of a simplest whole-number ratio of atoms.

rubric.why: The subscripts in glucose, C₆H₁₂O₆, reduce to the ratio 1:2:1.
rubric.description: Writes glucose’s empirical formula as CH₂O.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for the correct empirical formula, CH₂O.

modelAnswer: An empirical formula shows the simplest whole-number ratio of the atoms of each element in a compound.
For glucose, C₆H₁₂O₆, divide each subscript by 6: the empirical formula is CH₂O.

items.followUp: Write the subshell electronic configurations of carbon and fluorine.

rubric.why: Nitrogen has seven electrons distributed as 2, 2 and 3 among these subshells.
rubric.description: Gives nitrogen’s subshell electronic configuration as 1s² 2s² 2p³.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for the complete, correct configuration.

rubric.why: Oxygen has eight electrons distributed as 2, 2 and 4 among these subshells.
rubric.description: Gives oxygen’s subshell electronic configuration as 1s² 2s² 2p⁴.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for the complete, correct configuration.
